mapper.insert: insert into USERS (u_id, u_login_id, u_password, u_nickname, u_email) values (USERS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{u_login_id}, #{u_password}, #{u_nickname}, #{u_email})
mapper.select: select u_id, u_login_id, u_nickname, u_email, u_created_at from USERS where u_login_id = #{loginId} and u_password = #{password}
